slots.title: Are Plug-In Carbon Monoxide Detectors Reliable? The One You Should Unplug Today (2026)

slots.felt: The furnace just kicked on and the gas fireplace is going. The little plug-in alarm is the only thing between us and the air we can't smell.

slots.title: Does Hair Relaxer Cause Ovarian Cancer? Where the L'Oréal Lawsuits Stand (2026)
slots.why: L'Oréal USA Inc., the first defendant set for trial in the federal hair relaxer litigation (Revlon and others are also defendants). Thousands of women allege relaxers they used for years are linked to ovarian, endometrial and uterine cancer.
slots.felt: I relaxed my hair every six weeks for thirty years. Now I keep hearing the word cancer next to it and nobody will give me a straight answer.

slots.title: Is Clear Eyes Safe to Use Every Day? Why It Keeps Getting Pulled (2026)
slots.why: Prestige Consumer Healthcare (Prestige Brands Holdings and Medtech Products Inc.), maker of Clear Eyes. Its drops were recalled again in 2026 because the maker could not assure they were sterile.

slots.felt: The heat is on and my eyes are dry and red all day. I put these drops in three times a day. Am I putting germs straight into my eyes?

slots.title: Is TRESemmé Safe to Use? Why Unilever Is Being Sued Over Hair Loss (2026)
slots.why: Unilever (Conopco Inc. d/b/a Unilever Home & Personal Care USA). Six women say its TRESemmé shampoo and conditioner contained DMDM hydantoin, a formaldehyde releaser, and that their hair thinned and fell out.
slots.felt: My part is getting wider and there's more hair in the drain every week. I've used TRESemmé for twenty years. Did my shampoo do this?

slots.title: Why Is Beef So Expensive Right Now? Who the Justice Department Is Looking At (2026)
slots.why: The Big Four meatpackers, JBS, Cargill, Tyson Foods and National Beef, which the DOJ says handle more than 85% of U.S. beef processing and which are under a DOJ antitrust investigation over beef prices. The probe now also covers eight big grocers.
slots.keyword: why is beef so expensive right now
slots.felt: I picked up a roast, saw the price and put it back. Where is all that money going, because it sure isn't going to the rancher.

slots.title: Is Gotham Steel Safe to Cook With? What the 'Non-Toxic' Settlement Says (2026)
slots.why: E. Mishan & Sons, Inc., parent of Gotham Steel, Granite Stone and Bell & Howell cookware. It sold pans as 'Healthy, Non-Toxic' and 'Toxin Free', and buyers say the pans held metals and forever chemicals the box never mentioned.
slots.keyword: is gotham steel safe to cook with
slots.felt: I threw out my old Teflon to be safe and bought the one that said non-toxic right on the box. Did I just pay to get fooled twice?

slots.title: Why Was Argentina Beef Recalled? What Skipped Inspection Means for Your Meat (2026)
slots.why: Corte Argentino USA LLC of Aventura, FL, which brought in beef from Frigorifico Gorina SAIC in Argentina without U.S. import reinspection. Second villain: Star Meat Delivery Inc. of Lucama, NC, whose meat FSIS says carried a false USDA mark of inspection.
slots.felt: I trust the USDA stamp. If meat can skip inspection or carry a stamp that isn't real, what am I actually feeding my family?

slots.title: Is LiLash Safe? What a New Lawsuit Says Is Hiding in the Serum (2026)
